findings.reason: 'इससे' anchors on the nearest antecedent, the preceding 'पुराने संदेश', which gives a circular 'messages earlier than the older messages'. The discourse-deictic reading ('before what is shown') is available, so this is not a defect; dropping 'इससे' would remove the circularity and the repeat.

resolved_findings.fix: Applied in this round: the five-word verb clause 'ये भी देख सकते हैं' -> the nominal label 'अन्य पाठक' ('other readers'). Only that value changed; the hi context sidecar and every other hi key were untouched.
resolved_findings.reason: The sidecar asks for a label of three words at most that is not a sentence; the old value was five words ending in the finite verb हैं, so it closed as a sentence and its demonstrative ये pointed forward to names rendered in a separate <ul> below it. 'अन्य पाठक' is a nominal label that still carries the 'other readers' sense, has no colon, no placeholder and no sentence stop.
